findings.remediation: Delete the key from the code and read it from an environment variable (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID). Deactivate and rotate the key in AWS IAM. If it was pushed, purge it from history with git filter-repo.
Remove the secret key, load it from an environment variable or AWS Secrets Manager, and rotate it in AWS IAM straight away.
Revoke the token in GitHub Settings > Developer settings, create a new one, and store it in an environment variable or GitHub Actions secret.
Move the value to an environment variable, add its name (not the value) to .env.example, and rotate the key with the provider.
Do not keep passwords in code. Read it from an environment variable or a secrets manager.
